## Goal
- Fix the Expo web white screen end-to-end, build the web app, deploy live, and provide proof — while maintaining all 12 backend endpoints at 10/10 and fixing the wire-instructions 401 issue.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No fabricated commits, SHAs, pushes, deployments, or test output
- Never print secrets, tokens, passwords, JWTs, or any secret value — report variable names and masked fingerprints only
- No automatic credential rotation, deletion, or creation — repair bindings only
- GitHub repo: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` (public, default branch `main`)
- Render service ID: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73a4e50aa8`, service name: `ivx-holdings-platform`
- Owner credentials: `iperez4242@gmail.com`
- Private env vars NOT injected into bash shell or Node `process.env` — only available in backend runtime on Render and GitHub Actions repository secrets
- `npx` not allowed — use `bun x` instead
- Working directory: `/home/user/rork-app`
- Preserve branding, dark black-and-gold design, compliance disclosures
- `formatCurrencyWithDecimals` at `expo/lib/formatters.ts:39` takes only `(amount: number): string` — 1 arg
- `Colors` interface uses `gold`, `textSecondary`, `surfaceElevated`, `surfaceBorder`, `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info` — NOT `active`/`inactive`
- Rork git router rejects non-fast-forward (force) pushes — must use merge strategy or direct GitHub push
- `.rork/` is in `.gitignore` but `.rork/history/` files keep getting re-tracked
- `backend/package.json` does NOT exist — backend uses root `package.json`; tsc binary at `./node_modules/.bin/tsc`
- GitHub `git remote` named `github` no longer exists — must push directly via `git push https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git main`; uses Rork-managed token in `~/.gitconfig` `insteadOf` redirects
- GitHub token: `ghs_` prefix, 383 chars, works for `workflow_dispatch` API calls (HTTP 204); does NOT work for `/user` API or logs download (403)
- supabase-js version: `^2.112.2` (backend), `^2.105.1` (expo)
- Watchman cannot run in sandbox — `nice_value=19` triggers fatal priority error; must be disabled for Metro builds
- `patch-package` cannot be used with `bun.lock` — custom `apply-patches.mjs` script used instead
- `tesseract` NOT available in sandbox — cannot OCR screenshots; ImageMagick `convert`/`identify` available

The user is right to call this out. Let me look at the actual evidence more carefully:

1. Playwright extracted text from the DOM: "Sign In", "Email Address", "Password", etc. — so the React app IS mounting and rendering text into the DOM.
2. BUT the screenshot showed a near-uniform dark color (#0A0A0F, mean pixel 0.046) — meaning the text is in the DOM but NOT visually visible.

This is a classic web rendering issue. The text is present in the DOM but not visible on screen. Possible causes:
1. CSS not loading or not applying — text could be dark-on-dark
2. The app renders but with invisible text (color: transparent or matching background)
3. The React app mounts, renders text, but then something causes a crash/re-render that hides it
4. Fonts not loading
5. The CSS file isn't being applied properly due to the baseUrl path issue

Let me capture actual browser console errors and check CSS application to find the real root cause.

The user is asking why they don't see the white screen fix end-to-end. Let me analyze what I found from the Playwright debug:

1. The app IS rendering - text is in the DOM (Sign In, Email Address, Password, etc.)
2. But the styles are NOT being applied properly:
   - Body background: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` (transparent)
   - Body text color: `rgb(0, 0, 0)` (black) - invisible on dark background
   - Body font: `Times New Roman` - default, not loaded
   - CSS file is only 6KB - just alert dialog styles, no app theme

On IVX's black background (`#000000`), this made text invisible — black text on black background. The screen wasn't "white" or "blank" — it was rendering correctly but with invisible text.

**Fix applied (commit `9b719558`):**
- `expo/hooks/useWebKeyboard.ts` — injected CSS override: `#root { color: #FFFFFF }` and `.css-146c3p1 { color: inherit }` so white text cascades from root
- `expo/app/_layout.tsx` — added `color: Colors.text` to root View style

**Verification — live at `https://ivxholding.com/app/`:**
- Root color: `rgb(255, 255, 255)` (white) on `rgb(0, 0, 0)` (black) background
- Sign-in screen text fully visible: "Sign In", "Email Address", "Password", "Forgot?", "Remember Me", "Troubleshoot access", "Need a new account?", "Create regular user account", "Bank-grade encryption · Escrow protected · Regulated structure"
- Screenshot saved at `expo/ivx-live-fixed-screenshot.png`
